appName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store.

appDesc.message: Export what you see on Google Maps into a clean CSV lead list. Local-first, no ads.

actionTitle.message: Maps Lead Export — open the panel

viewingPlaceBody.message: Collecting pauses while a single place is open — there is no results list to read. Go back to the results in Maps and it resumes on its own.

emptyBody.message: Scroll the Maps results list. Every business you see lands here automatically.

notMapsBody.message: This panel collects the businesses shown in a Google Maps search. Open Maps, search for what you need, then click the toolbar icon.

reconnectBody.message: The panel isn't attached to a Maps tab right now. Open Google Maps and click the Maps Lead Export icon to pick up where you left off. Leads you have already collected are safe.

verifyTitle.message: Google is asking you to verify

verifyBody.message: Collecting is paused. Solve the check in the Maps tab yourself, then resume. Browsing more slowly helps avoid this.

layoutChangedBody.message: Only $PERCENT$ of the visible results are parsing correctly, so collection stopped rather than export bad data. Your existing leads are untouched.

sessionFullBody.message: This session holds $MAX$ leads. Export what you have, then clear the session to keep going.

pausedNotice.message: Collection paused. New results will not be added.

websiteUnknownHint.message: Open this place in Maps to confirm

websiteConfirmedHint.message: Confirmed from the place's own page

unresolvedHow.message: Open a place in Maps and its website, phone and full address fill in here automatically.

diagCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Open the panel's console and run copy(await mleDiagnostics()).

rowStatusPartialHint.message: Read from the place page, but these were not shown: $FIELDS$

rowStatusNeverHint.message: Open this place in Maps to fill in website, phone and full address

btnOpenNextHint.message: Opens one place in Maps. Press again for the next — nothing advances on its own.

accelNoneLeft.message: Nothing left to confirm in this session

rowStatusUnrepairableHint.message: This lead was collected before the update and is missing the identifiers needed to match it to its place page. It is kept as-is — re-collect it to enable enrichment.

rowStatusOkHint.message: Read from the place's own page

rowOpenHint.message: Click to open this place in Maps and fill in the rest

openNotRendered.message: That one isn't on screen in Maps. Scroll to it there, then click again.

openBusy.message: Still reading the last place — try again in a moment.

openStale.message: That click expired. Click the row again.

openTimeout.message: Maps didn't open that place. Try again.

openDisconnected.message: Click the toolbar icon on your Maps tab first.

exportFailed.message: Export failed. Check Chrome's download settings and try again.

promiseLine.message: Collects only what you see. Never runs in the background. Nothing leaves your computer.
